BAS_EMS.note: Combined BAS/EMS + telemetry database only. Do not apply to independently separated telemetry DB.

TELEMETRY_ISOLATED.note: Telemetry-owned foundation, reading source, asset hierarchy and storage policies. PLAN ONLY; deployment and data migration not approved.

BAS_EMS_ISOLATED.note: REVIEW ONLY: Energy-owned migrations. External Telemetry and Platform relationships require tenant-aware service validation; region backfill is deferred. Do not apply.

PLATFORM_ISOLATED.note: Review-only regional reference-data foundation; NOT the complete Platform schema. Development-tenant seed scripts are excluded.

warnings: No migrations are executed by this manifest.
Never run existing schema migrations against a populated target without backup and review.
Telemetry.Readings and Telemetry.StoragePolicies depend on Telemetry.Devices/Sites/MeasurementDefinitions; BAS equipment commands and Energy contracts depend on Telemetry tables.
Regional configuration needs explicit product/platform ownership before relocation.
TELEMETRY_ISOLATED and BAS_EMS_ISOLATED are incomplete review-only foundation plans. No isolated apply is permitted.
PLATFORM_ISOLATED is only a regional-reference foundation, not the full Platform schema. Development tenant seeds must not run automatically.
